mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines by >0.25pp over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in <40% of UNRATE >5.0% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative 60-day returns occur in <60% of HOUST and RSAFS decline instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (indicated by a 3-month decline in industrial production), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as firms face higher input costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not negative in >60% of INDPRO decline instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) relative to its 12-month average signals strong economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 > 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in <40% of CPIAUCSL >3.0% y/y instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as corporate hiring slows and consumer spending weakens.
failure_condition: Negative 60-day returns occur in <60% of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (indicated by FEDFUNDS rising above 5.0% and remaining elevated for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are not negative in >60% of FEDFUNDS >5.0% sustained instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
